resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register, Firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed in 1973; Forest Lookouts says the lookout house was removed in 1973. All agree the lookout ended in 1973, and the story reports both words.
Register gives 5,335 ft (1,626 m) for the site; WillhiteWeb gives a summit elevation of 5,353 feet. The story uses the Register figure for the site.

sources.title: Bare Mountain Trail - North Fork Snoqualmie

notes_for_editor: Gone site with a clear end date (1973) but a destroyed-or-removed conflict. No source describes the summit today. Access is marked public only because WillhiteWeb describes a hike with no closure; no source addresses access rules, so the editor may want to soften it. The brief has no design field, so the L-4 design comes from the Register and Firelookout.com. The 1942 Seattle Filter Center activation is recorded as stated; the page does not say what the work was.
